verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no user-facing setting or documented policy that lets a user opt in or out of their conversations being used for model training. The only related item is a runtime probe noting that llms.txt documents "ZDR model routing". That is a vendor-side zero-data-retention routing practice, an adjacent behavior rather than a user control, and it never explicitly addresses training. Per-user isolated machines are about data separation, not training consent.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
